title: Armour of Agility
summary: Add your full Dexterity modifier to AC. Gain +2 to all saving throws and avoid armour-imposed Stealth disadvantage.

fields.Effect: Add your full Dexterity modifier to AC, gain +2 to all saving throws, and avoid armour-imposed Stealth disadvantage.
fields.Base value: 2900 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Reported feat interaction: The linked passive source reports that Exotic Material stops working with Medium Armour Master or Magic Initiate: Cleric. The +2 saving throw bonus is a separate property.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
